captions.youtube_title: Viewer Donations on Your Stream: Gift or Income?
captions.youtube_description: Money viewers send while you stream is reportable income, even with no Form 1099. Source: IRS Gig economy tax center. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games. General information, not advice for your situation.
captions.pinterest_title: Viewer Donations on Your Stream Count as Income
captions.pinterest_description: Tips, bits and donations from viewers go on your tax return, form or no form. Source: IRS.
captions.pinterest_alt: Sunset card: Viewers tipped your stream? It counts as income.

sources.fact: Gig economy income must be reported even if not on a 1099 or W-2 and paid in any form incl. cash, property, goods

voice: Viewers tipped your GTA VI stream? Myth: donations are just gifts. Fact: money viewers send for your stream is income you report, even with no 1099. Tips, bits, subs, ad money, even gear you get for content. Log every payout by month, then subtract your stream costs. Link in bio.
